name: Ray of Command — "That creature gains haste" takes only a creature an opponent controls
notes: Memory: project_pronoun_target_antecedent_restriction_2026-10-14. 'Untap target creature an opponent controls and gain control of it until end of turn. That creature gains haste until end of turn.' The haste effect became the spell's target with no restriction and the picker offered every permanent, yours and lands included. It now takes its antecedent's restriction ('… and gain control of it' cut off). The list is read before a target is chosen, as the audit reads it: once the Ogre is taken, the picker reads the board after the control change and no longer lists it.
